jobs.description: The industrial-complex edge (root ADR-0456; its own job since root ADR-0563 §3; scripts/ops/industrial-complex-edge-export.sh): the publisher reads the current gold.complex_catalog and gold.complex_document_facts, writes a create-only profile only for the complexes whose content hash differs from the one the edge index holds, and publishes a new index generation only when an entry changed (`changed`); otherwise it writes nothing (`unchanged`). No Spark, so it holds no spark slot: started when a run of the lineage cycle (the complexes' region codes) or of the fact job (a complex's document facts) says it changed its table, and daily as the fallback for a hand-rebuilt Gold (root ADR-0171). A stopped run leaves profiles no index points at; the next run finds them byte-identical and publishes the index.

first_run.estimated_from: computed (root ADR-0386): the same command as a step of lineage_stewardship, whose whole run with no lineage work took 222 s at p50 (30 runs, its measured_run_seconds); the export reads two Gold tables of one row per complex and the index, hashes each row, and writes only the changed complexes' profiles, eight at a time; its first run under this job writes the profiles of the complexes whose document facts were folded since the last lineage run (one on 2026-11-13)

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when a complex's Gold row or its document facts change; a complex's region codes change a few times a year and facts arrive with new notices. That it keeps finishing is the done bound.

assets.title: 산업단지 엣지 문서(목록·프로필)
assets.description: 필지 엣지(catalog.perfectory.io)가 서빙하는 산업단지 목록 한 장과 단지마다의 Gold 프로필(루트 ADR-0456). 프로필은 gold.complex_catalog 의 줄에, 관문을 넘은 문서 사실(gold.complex_document_facts, 루트 ADR-0477 §5)이 있으면 그것을 더한 것이다. 내용이 바뀐 단지만 새 프로필을 쓰고, 목록은 항목이 바뀌었을 때만 새 세대를 낸다. 둘 중 한 표가 바뀌면 바로 내보낸다(루트 ADR-0563 §3).

dependencies.description: 단지의 Gold 줄이 프로필의 본문이고 목록의 항목이다. 내용 해시가 바뀐 단지만 다시 쓴다.
단지의 현재 문서 사실이 프로필의 document_facts 가 된다. 사실이 바뀐 단지는 내용 해시가 달라져 그 단지만 다시 쓴다.
